notes.title: First Demo Update
notes.content:
In the first Official Update you can expect the following:

More Objectives to direct you so you have specific goals to complete

Outline items to be easily distinguishable in the darkness

Beer mechanics! Cause who doesn't like beer (Careful as its permanent!)

Extra Puzzle: Padlock with numbers

More Audio diversity

Minor Bug Fixes

Before entering the game I advice to try out your microphone in the Main Menu > Options > Test Mic.

You can also select your microphone from the button above

If you have any problems then you might have to make the microphone you want, the default microphone in your computer.
